body: Operator report: the service disk filled overnight because its log file grew without bound. app/logwriter.py LogWriter is constructed with max_bytes but write() never checks it, so no rotation ever happens. Implement the documented rotation contract: before writing a line that would make the active file exceed max_bytes, rename the active file to '<path>.1' (replacing any previous backup) and start a fresh active file, then write the line to the fresh file. Small writes below the limit must append exactly as today with no backup created. Acceptance: writing lines whose total exceeds max_bytes produces a '<path>.1' backup holding the earlier content and an active file containing the latest line and no larger than max_bytes for single lines under the limit; repeated rotation replaces the old backup instead of accumulating files; existing tests still pass.
title: Log writer never rotates and fills the disk
